messages:
violet chen: Heads-up: Candidate Leo Park visiting Fri 2026-09-03 requesting neurodiversity accommodations. Needs reduced sensory room, ability to take extra breaks, and prefers panel questions sent 24h ahead. Can we coordinate?
samir malik: Thanks for flagging. We should be able to do reduced-sensory room and extended breaks. Who can own sending the pared-down question set?
eve han: I can draft the 24h question set (high-level only, no answers) and send via email. Also confirm candidate prefers a single day with a slightly later start (11:00-15:30) to avoid morning rush.
violet chen: Yes, candidate asked for 11:00 start. Also asked that interviewers avoid rapid-fire follow-ups and allow extra time to answer. Please add this accommodation note to the invite.
facilities-bot: Reserved Reduced Sensory Room R3 for 10:30-16:00. We'll set lighting to low and disable nearby building announcements. Noise-canceling headphones available on request.
samir malik: Can we shorten panels to 30m each and include 10m buffer between them for breaks?
eve han: That works. Proposed blocks: Intro 11:00-11:30, System 11:40-12:10, Lunch break 12:10-13:00, Coding 13:00-14:00 (extended time allowed), Final culture loop 14:10-14:40, 15:00 quick debrief.
recruiter-bot: Calendar invite created: 2026-09-03T11:00:00-07:00 to 2026-09-03T15:30:00-07:00. Note: accommodation flag included. Zoom link added for remote fallback.
violet chen: Also request: loaner laptop with an external mouse and US keyboard, and ability to use dark mode in terminal. Can IT ensure the terminal defaults to dark theme?
samir malik: @it please confirm loaner config and terminal theme. Also confirm parking and lobby pickup.
eve han: I'll include a short primer in the invite that explains the structure and timings so candidate knows what to expect. Keep tone simple and concrete.
facilities-bot: Loaner assigned: LB-9981 with external mouse and US keyboard. Will be configured with dark terminal theme. Parking: Visitor Lot D, permit printed at front desk. Lobby pickup volunteer: Samir at 10:50.
violet chen: Expense note: candidate traveling from out of town - will expense one-night hotel and transit. Policy: reimburse < $120 taxi auto; otherwise submit expense form. I'll CC finance.
samir malik: One more operational ask: interviewers should avoid surprise whiteboard tasks; please provide any prompt context at the start. I'll notify the panel.
eve han: Agreed. I'll add a small interviewer guidance doc to the invite reminding folks to pause, avoid interruptions, and use plain language.
violet chen: Perfect. Thanks team. I'll send the candidate confirmation now with room details, accessibility notes, and contact number. Please reply here if any issues. :white_check_mark:
